title: Road Hazard Certificate Proration Terms for Worn Tires — Northgate Tire Center
content:
# Proration of a road hazard credit on a worn tire

**Term.** Where the wear of the damaged tire is above the package's full-credit wear limit, the Northgate Tire Center road hazard credit share is decided by the road hazard proration method:

| Damaged tire | Months on the wheel up to the replacement entry | Credit share |
|---|---|---|
| treadwear warranty miles above zero | fewer than 12 whole calendar months | the greater of the road hazard usable tread share and the road hazard warranty miles share |
| treadwear warranty miles above zero | 12 or more whole calendar months | the road hazard warranty miles share |
| no treadwear mileage warranty (warranty miles of zero) | any | the road hazard usable tread share |

The full-credit wear limit is 25 percent of usable tread on the Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard and on the Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard, and 50 percent on Northgate Premium Tire Care; Northgate Tire Mount & Balance, the Northgate Tire Installation Package and the Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package show 0.

## Definitions

- **Mounting point.** The tire on the damaged wheel counts as mounted at the package's installation odometer and installation date or, where a treadwear claim entry is recorded for that wheel position, at the odometer and service date of the latest such claim entry.
- **Months on the wheel.** The whole calendar months from the mounting date up to the service date of the replacement entry (the most recent road hazard replacement entry on the package); a month counts once its day of the month is reached.
- **Road hazard warranty miles share.** The treadwear warranty miles less the miles from the mounting odometer to the odometer on the replacement entry, never below zero, divided by the treadwear warranty miles.
- **Road hazard usable tread share.** The remaining tread on the replacement entry less the coverage-end tread depth, divided by the new tire tread depth less the coverage-end tread depth, never below zero.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: warranty 50000 miles, new tread 10/32, coverage-end 2/32, remaining tread 5/32, so usable tread share 0.375)

| Mounted | Replacement entry | Months on the wheel | Miles since mounting | Warranty miles share | Credit share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-03-01 at 20000 miles (treadwear claim entry on that wheel) | 2025-11-15 at 30000 miles | 8 | 10000 | 0.8 | 0.8, the greater |
| 2024-01-10 at 5000 miles (installation) | 2025-01-09 at 47000 miles | 11 | 42000 | 0.16 | 0.375, the greater |
| 2024-01-10 at 5000 miles (installation) | 2025-01-10 at 47000 miles | 12 | 42000 | 0.16 | 0.16 |

For a tire whose warranty miles are zero, the same 5/32 tire takes the usable tread share, 0.375, however long it was on the wheel.
